population: All opponent-held objectives at original156 start-of-player-turn windows in12unique historic temperate trajectories;8map seeds. Neutral/own-held objectives retained for accounting only.
label: Mover controls the same initially opponent-held target at end of its player-turn window.
primaryContrast: M3 rules+ratio+baseline versus M1 proximity/occupancy/time/role baseline
objective: SUM Bernoulli cross entropy plus0.5*squared standardized slopes, lambda1, intercept unpenalized; single-class folds useM0
split: Leave one complete map seed out, pooled-role fits. Same held-out predictions scored by role.
selection: No hyperparameter or feature selection. All models reported. Only retainedCapture fitted.
uncertainty: 1000 paired complete seed-cluster resamples of fixed out-of-fold errors; no refitting or selection uncertainty.
scopeLimitations: Historical, exploratory, already-inspected source cohort; not independent prospective validation
Conditional odds from real adjacent formation do not establish legal multi-action combat, joint fuel or supply payment
Retained enemy-objective acquisition omits neutral acquisition and defense of currently-held targets; not full netVP or terminal-margin model
No policy/source rule changes, new matches, promotion or UI acceptance
